cardNote: The club-hosted scorecard and current detailed transcription agree on Back tee pars, indexes and 6,217-yard per-hole row. Current public rating summaries disagree on course length, so rating and slope are deliberately unset. Middle and Forward are withheld from this release to avoid mixing editions. All 18 original numbered routes carry matching pars.
